nodes.title: SG-6.1 · Anchored, event-driven overlays
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx owns selectedId, hoverId, layout, round state and passes view, objectsSpec, layout, node, history, inventory and round data into the three overlays as props, and PhaserHost reports layout through an onLayout callback prop. Desired behaviour: each overlay sources its own data from the typed bridge (phaserToReact events) or the Zustand stores, positions through lib/anchor.ts anchorFor, and re-anchors whenever PhaserHost reports a new canvas rect, zoom or dpr. Expected result: App only composes; the player sees and does exactly what they do today. Why: SG-6 overlays per game-ui-ux.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the canvas is resized, When PhaserHost's ResizeObserver fires, Then ObjectOverlay's plaque and action panel move to the new anchorFor result without a prop from App
- Given an objectHover, objectClick, focusChange or menuClose event or a store focus change, When it occurs, Then ObjectOverlay shows or hides the right object with no state held in App
- Given the game store changes, When StoryPanel renders, Then dialogue node, history and inventory come from the store with no data props
- Given the round store changes, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then loading, error, ready and empty states come from the store and Retry reloads through the store


## Scope
- In scope: PhaserHost layout reporting through the store
- In scope: ObjectOverlay, StoryPanel and HeaderOverlay data sourcing
- In scope: App.tsx reduced to composition
- In scope: rewriting prop-based overlay tests against behaviour
- Out of scope: IntroScreen and ContributionSheet Radix work (SG-6.2)
- Out of scope: Splitting ContributionSheet, AdminApp, App (SG-6.3)
- Out of scope: backend/ and api/client.ts changes
- Out of scope: new features or visual changes
- Preserve: Boys-room gameplay, transitions and animations
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: api/client.ts endpoints and payloads


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped; internals-pinning tests rewritten against behaviour
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- Tests mock only the API client, Phaser and the network


## Definition of done
- All four requirements delivered and verified
- Both packages green on test and typecheck


## Non-functional requirements
- No per-frame allocations added; listeners released on unmount


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Canvas layout reaches overlays through the store and anchors on resize
nodes.body:
Context: PhaserHost.tsx calls an onLayout prop from reportLayout; App keeps it in useState and passes it to ObjectOverlay. Desired: PhaserHost writes the layout to useUiStore (canvasLayout) on mount, ResizeObserver and dpr change, so any overlay can anchor itself. Expected: onLayout prop gone. Why: re-anchor on resize without App.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given PhaserHost mounts, When reportLayout runs, Then useUiStore.getState().canvasLayout equals {left, top, zoom, dpr} from the container rect and computeZoom
- Given the ResizeObserver callback fires with a new container size, When applyZoom runs, Then canvasLayout holds the new zoom
- Given PhaserHost has no onLayout prop, When App renders, Then it compiles and mounts PhaserHost with scenes only


## Scope
- In scope: CanvasLayout type in lib/anchor.ts
- In scope: uiStore canvasLayout and setCanvasLayout
- In scope: PhaserHost reporting
- In scope: App dropping layout state
- Out of scope: Changing computeZoom maths
- Preserve: Zoom and dpr behaviour of PhaserHost
- Preserve: single Phaser game instance, destroyed on unmount


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- No visible change
- No file over 200 lines
- Zustand store owns shared state


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- onLayout removed
- canvasLayout in store updated on resize and dpr change


## Non-functional requirements
- Listeners released on unmount


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: ObjectOverlay is event- and store-driven and anchored through anchorFor
nodes.body:
Context: App holds selectedId/hoverId and passes view, objectsSpec, layout, activeId, focusFirstAction and onAction. Desired: a hook subscribes to phaserToReact objectHover, objectClick, menuClose and store focusedObjectId; ObjectOverlay reads game state and canvasLayout from stores and positions with anchorFor; actions run through a shared runtime function that also emits playAnimation and transitionTo.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given objectHover {id:'bed'}, When ObjectOverlay is mounted with no props, Then the bed plaque and actions render at anchorFor of canvasLayout
- Given canvasLayout changes in the store, When the overlay re-renders, Then its left/top style equals the new anchorFor result
- Given menuClose is emitted, Then the click selection clears and the overlay hides unless hover or store focus is set
- Given an action button is clicked, Then runStep runs, playAnimation interact is emitted and transitionTo is emitted on goto_scene
- Given App source, Then it holds no selectedId, hoverId or handleAction


## Scope
- In scope: ObjectOverlay.tsx
- In scope: new useActiveObject hook
- In scope: new runtime/objectActions.ts
- In scope: useGame delegating act
- In scope: App.tsx
- Out of scope: Visual or a11y changes
- Preserve: Priority hover > store focus > last click
- Preserve: focusFirstAction behaviour
- Preserve: aria-live announcement


## Technical constraints
- Zustand store only owner of GameState
- game/src never imports frontend
- No file over 200 lines
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- ObjectOverlay takes no data props


## Non-functional requirements
- Subscriptions released on unmount


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: HeaderOverlay reads round status from the store and retries through it
nodes.body:
Context: App fetches getCurrentRound, holds round/loading/error and passes them with onRetry and worldTitle. Desired: uiStore holds round, roundLoading, roundError and loadRound() (same getCurrentRound call, 404 -> no round, describeRoundError message); HeaderOverlay selects them and reads world.title from runtime/content; App triggers loadRound once on mount.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given getCurrentRound resolves a round, When loadRound runs, Then store round is set and HeaderOverlay shows id, status and countdown
- Given getCurrentRound rejects with ApiError 404, Then the header shows 'No active round'
- Given it rejects otherwise, Then the header shows 'Round unavailable: <describeRoundError message>' and Retry calls loadRound
- Given loadRound runs, Then roundLoading is true until it settles and the header shows 'Loading round…'
- Given App, Then describeRoundError is still exported and no round state lives in App


## Scope
- In scope: uiStore round slice
- In scope: lib/roundError.ts
- In scope: HeaderOverlay.tsx
- In scope: App.tsx
- Out of scope: api/client.ts
- Out of scope: Suggest button and ContributionSheet wiring
- Preserve: Header markup, test ids, sound/settings controls, onSuggest and suggestRef props


## Technical constraints
- api/client.ts unchanged, same endpoints and payloads
- Store owns shared state
- No file over 200 lines


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- HeaderOverlay has no round or worldTitle props


## Clarifying questions
